newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia lowers trade deficit in Jan-Feb, exports up.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia lowers trade deficit in Jan-Feb, exports up.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit fell to 324.1 million dinars ($302.4 million) during the first two months of 1997 from 409.4 million dinars during the same period last year, official statistics showed on Tuesday.
Exports rose 13 percent year-on-year to 909.7 million dinars and imports were up by 1.6 percent to 1,233.8 million dinars.
Food exports, including olive oil, rose by 83.3 percent, and mechanical and electrical products exports were up 22.3 percent.
Exports of textiles, Tunisia's major manufacturing industry earner of foreign currency, rose to 346.4 million dinars from 320 million dinars a year ago.

Import increases were tempered by better climatic conditions for agriculture which made food imports, including that of cereals, fall by 12.8 percent compared to the same period last year. Imports of capital goods increased by 13.5 percent.
